answer.explanation: My 14:00 patrol note for the dining table on day 5 (v056) lists a white wine glass there, along with the orchid vase, the stone bowl, a gold-and-white placemat or book, and papers. The wine glass was also there at 12:00 (v040) and 16:00 (v072).

At 20:00 my notes say a small orange carrot piece appeared on the island. At 22:00 they record no changes and list a 'small orange crayon or carrot'. The 22:00 picture shows the same small orange carrot-like piece on the counter near the blue yogurt cup.
My 20:00 note for the bathroom 1 vanity top (v111) lists a yellow soap pump bottle. That is a hand soap dispenser. It was also there at every other patrol that day.

At 16:00 on day 7 my picture of the entryway floor shows a pair of short, dark, slightly glossy boots near the door. My notes call them 'black ankle boots'. They look like short rubber rain boots, so I count them as rain boots, but the picture can't confirm what they're made of. The lime-green backpack, rolled newspaper and red sneakers were also there.

At 12:00 on day 7 I photographed the island countertop (v033). The picture shows a dark woven basket, a milk carton, a gold foil snack bag, a blue yogurt cup, a green glass bowl, a white mug or canister, a white paper bag, a wooden spoon and a red plate. There is no field notebook on the island.

My 20:00 note for the nightstand (v108) lists a lamp, a white mug, two white phone chargers with cables, a brown leather case, a lotion bottle, the 'Cool London' book and a green-and-purple glasses case. It does not list a phone. Nothing on the nightstand changed between 12:00 and 22:00. In the 22:00 picture the green-and-purple object is a small rectangular case, not a phone. Only empty chargers are there.

At 16:00 I noted no changes at the vanity top. The white-and-red handheld item was still on the tissue box. In the kept 08:00 and 10:00 pictures, that item looks like a white tube with a red cap, which is most likely a toothpaste tube. It stayed in place through 16:00, so a toothpaste was most likely there.

There's no 12:00 picture, but the 12:00 note (v043) reports no changes since 10:00 and lists no water bottle. The clear water bottle with the blue cap left the desk between 08:00 and 10:00 (v027) and didn't show up again until 22:00. The 10:00 and 20:00 pictures look the same and have no clear bottle. The dark cylinder behind the tablet is a black speaker (v059, v107), not a water bottle.

My note from the 12:00 patrol of the island countertop on day 5 (v033) lists a yellow banana among the items. The banana is also in my notes from 10:00 (v017) and 14:00 (v049), so it was there the whole time.

At 18:00 on day 6 there was an olive green glass oil bottle with a black spout on the countertop by the range. It stood between the pepper mill and the crisps bag. Someone set it there between 12:00 and 14:00 (v053), and it was still there at 16:00 and 18:00.

My 14:00 note for the bathroom 2 floor on day 4 (v064) lists a black toiletry bag with a brass zipper pull. The same black boxy bag with a brass item appears in my notes at that spot from 08:00 through 22:00, and none of them record it leaving.

My 14:00 note for the bathroom 1 vanity top (v063) lists a wooden tissue box with tissues, a small white-and-red spray bottle, a yellow pump soap bottle, toilet paper rolls, a blue item behind, black hanging towels and a jute rug. No toothpaste is listed. My notes from 12:00 and 16:00 don't show one either, and the usual-contents note doesn't mention toothpaste.

My 16:00 note for the bathroom 2 floor (v080) lists a dark plaid sock next to the jeans, glasses and black bag. Nothing there changed between 14:00 and 22:00. The 22:00 picture (v128) shows that same thick, dark red plaid sock, which looks like a wool sock. So a wool-type sock was there at 16:00. I can't confirm the material from a picture, though, and it was a single sock, not a pair.

In the 10:00 picture there is a black-handled spatula lying flat on the counter in front of the oil bottle and pepper mill. My note called it a 'steel slotted spatula'. In the picture the head is a matte grey slotted blade, which could be silicone, so the material label is uncertain. A spatula was clearly there, and it had just appeared at this time.

I have a picture of the countertop by the range from 20:00 (v101). It shows the crisps bag, a silver foil bag, a black knife, the cutting board with a white crumpled cloth or bag, the orange carrot, a long wooden spoon and a tipped-over white bowl. There is no silicone spatula. The only spatula seen here earlier was a steel slotted one, and it was already gone by 18:00 (v085).

My 18:00 note for the countertop beside the kitchen sink on day 4 (v083) lists a tall black thermos there. The same thermos also appears at 16:00 (v067) and at 20:00 (v099), where it had been moved within the place. I relied on the notes and did not open the picture.

My 08:00 note for the dining table on day 5 (v008) lists a white wine glass on the table and says it had moved within the place. There's no kept picture from that visit. Later notes show the wine glass there all day too.

At 18:00 (v085) the green olive oil bottle stood behind the cutting board. In the 20:00 picture (v101), a white crumpled bag covers most of the bottle, but its black-and-cork neck still shows above the bag in the same spot, so the bottle was hidden, not gone. My 22:00 note (v117) records no changes since 20:00. So the olive oil bottle was still there at 22:00, just hidden behind the bag.

At 12:00 the left cooktop had the brown egg, the black low casserole pan, a small dark grey canister, the small blue kettle behind the egg and the silver snack bag. Behind the egg at the back right there is also a dark pan handle. That is most likely the small black pot that my notes place on the range next to the counter. I saw no saucepan. The steel saucepan with a long handle first appeared at 14:00 (v052).

My 08:00 picture of the bedroom 1 floor shows soft dark grey trousers lying at the bottom left. A second dark folded pair of trousers is near the doorway, next to the silver ballet flat. These look like loose lounge pants dropped on the floor. My notes cannot confirm that they are lounge pants rather than some other kind of trousers.

My 12:00 note for the left cooktop (v036) lists a silver snack bag, a white crumpled cloth or bag, a red-orange sausage, a small blue kettle, a paper towel roll and empty grates. It lists no ladle. I recorded no changes between the 10:00 photo and 12:00, and that photo (v020) shows the same things. The orange item in it is a sausage, not a ladle.
My note from the 08:00 patrol of the office desk on day 3 (v011) lists a clear water bottle with a blue cap on the desk. By 10:00 it was gone (v027).

In my 10:00 picture of the bathroom 2 floor, a pair of black bottoms with white trim lies under a white t-shirt. Both items appeared between 08:00 and 10:00, which fits someone taking off sleepwear in the morning. My note calls them 'black shorts', but they look like pajama bottoms. This is my best reading of the picture, not a certain match.

There was no new picture at 18:00, but the note for that pass (v091) says the desk was unchanged. In the 12:00 and 14:00 pictures, small white printed paper scraps sit in front of the keyboard and look like receipts. They were still there at 14:00, and no changes were noted at 16:00 or 18:00, so they were most likely still on the desk at 18:00.
My 08:00 note for the dining table on day 3 (v008) lists a white wine glass on the white round marble tabletop. It was there along with the orchid vase, the stone bowl and the plates.

My 14:00 note for the countertop by the range (v053) lists a green oil bottle, a small white bowl with a wooden spoon, a pepper mill, a crisps bag and a spatula. It lists no canned tomatoes. Nothing changed there between 14:00 and 16:00, and the 16:00 picture (v069) shows the same items with no can.
My note for the countertop by the range at 08:00 on day 5 lists only a wooden pepper mill, a yellow and white crisps bag and a white round bowl. It records no wooden spoon, so one was not there.

My 08:00 note for the bedroom 1 floor (v014) lists what was there: dark grey trousers, a potted plant, a curtain, a white carpet and wall panels. No kitchen clogs are listed. I have no picture of that spot at that time, but the note covers it, so the answer is no.

At 10:00 on day 3 the desk top had a monitor, a keyboard, a tablet in a blue case, a dark glass bottle, a red apple and a white mug. I kept a picture of it, and neither the picture nor my note shows a wallet.

My note for the bedroom 1 floor at 18:00 on day 7 (v094) says nothing changed. It lists only the white carpet, the tall plant in its dark brown pot, the curtain, the wall panels and the view through the doorway. No lounge pants or other clothes were on the floor. My usual-items note also says nothing appeared on this floor on day 7.

My 12:00 note for the island (v033) lists a brown egg, a woven basket with towels, a white bottle with a blue cap, a green glass bottle, a blue yogurt cup, a yellow snack bag and a black flat case. It records no changes since 10:00. The 10:00 picture (v017) shows the same items and no field notebook. The only flat dark item is the black flat case behind the banana, and I logged it as a case, not a notebook.

The 10:00 picture (v019) shows a tall black thermos, an orange detergent bottle, a rolled towel, a crumpled white bag, a brown bowl and a blue-and-white dish in the sink. There is no water bottle. The blue-and-white plastic water bottle first appears at 12:00 (v035). This answer treats the black thermos as a thermos, not a water bottle.

At 16:00 on day 3 I photographed the left cooktop. The picture shows a black frying pan, an olive green bottle, a small blue kettle, a white bowl and a small tan board. There is also a small yellow item mostly hidden behind the bottle. I can't make out a silicone spatula, and none of my notes from that visit list one.

My 14:00 note for the dining table (v056) lists a white wine glass, the orchid vase, a stone bowl, a gold placemat and papers. No water glass is listed. Nothing changed between 14:00 and 18:00, and the 18:00 picture (v088) shows the only glass is a stemmed white wine glass, not a water glass.

At 18:00 on day 7 I photographed the kitchen sink basin (v082). The picture shows a blue-and-white plastic bottle, a tall black bottle, a paper towel roll, a beige rolled towel, the orange Ace detergent bottle, a white plate and the faucet. There is no mug anywhere in it, and my note for that patrol does not list one either.

My 14:00 note for the bathroom 2 floor (v064) lists light blue jeans, reading glasses, two white socks, camouflage trousers, a plaid sock, a black bag, a white shirt and a hanging towel. There was no dress. The floor had not changed since 08:00, and the 08:00 picture (v016) also shows no dress, only a white shirt or top.

I photographed the island at 08:00 on day 7. The picture shows a large black open case, a gold foil snack bag, a small white cup or jar at the far left edge, a small orange item and some white bits. There is no green oil bottle or any other olive oil bottle. The olive oil bottle that day was on the counter by the range.

My 08:00 note for the dining table on day 6 lists a white marble round table, a white wine glass, a dark grey stone bowl, a white plate with a blue rim, a grey ribbed vase with a white orchid, a gold-and-white book or tray, and a small clear glass item at the back. No honey jar is listed. I didn't keep a picture of this spot, so this answer comes from the note alone.
My 18:00 note on day 7 (v081) says the island countertop was bare, with only the snake plant behind it. The picture I kept confirms this: the counter is empty and there is no menu folder on it.

At 16:00 on day 5 I photographed the island. My note lists a basket of towels, a plate, a bowl, an egg, an oil bottle, a cup, a yogurt cup, a banana, a snack bag, an orange pencil and a dark brown curved object, with no carrot. In the picture, the small orange thing on the right is a sharpened pencil and the orange round thing behind the plate is the brown egg. There is no carrot.

At 22:00 on day 6 my note for the left cooktop (v116) lists a steel saucepan, a black low casserole pan, a tall black stockpot, a white round bowl, an olive green oil bottle and the black range. It lists no carrot, so the answer is no.

At 14:00 on day 3 the left cooktop had a green glass bottle, a black frying pan, a white candle and a white bowl on the counter. My note lists no canned tomatoes, and the kept picture doesn't show any.

At 20:00 on day 5 my note and picture of the countertop beside the sink show a tall black thermos, an orange detergent bottle, a rolled cream towel, a crumpled plastic bag and a white plate in the sink. There is no bowl. The brown patterned bowl had already gone between 08:00 and 10:00 (v019).

My 10:00 note for the island (v017) lists the basket with towels, a brown bowl, a white plate with a green rim, a snack bag, a bottle with a blue cap, a banana, an oil bottle, an egg, a mug and a yogurt cup. The picture shows the same things. There is no field notebook in the note or the picture.

The 08:00 picture shows a black key fob with a red tag on the nightstand. My 12:00 note lists the lamp, mug, chargers, brown leather case, lotion bottle, London book and green-and-purple case, with no keys. The pen and plug adapter seen at 08:00 are also missing from that note. The 22:00 picture matches the 12:00 note exactly, and no changes were noted in between, so the keys had already been taken by 12:00.

My 20:00 note for the entryway floor (v105) lists black ankle boots, a rolled newspaper, red sneakers, a small brown item, an armchair, curtains and a coat rack. It lists no jacket. Nothing changed by 22:00, and that picture (v121) shows no jacket on the floor or on the coat rack.

My 20:00 note for this countertop (v099) lists a tall black thermos. It is the same tall black cylindrical bottle that the sink-basin view records. In the 08:00 picture (v002) it looks like an insulated drink or water bottle. It came back at 16:00 (v067), was still there at 18:00 (v083) and 22:00 (v115), and no note says it left. I kept no picture from 20:00, so this answer comes from the note.

At 10:00 on day 4 I photographed the bedroom 1 floor. The picture shows one dark grey garment with two legs, so it is the pair of trousers, not a cardigan. The rest of the frame shows a potted tree, curtains and furniture through the doorway, and no cardigan or other top. My note from that patrol lists the same things.

My 12:00 note (v040) for the dining table lists a white wine glass, an orchid in a grey pot, a stone bowl, a gold-and-white runner and papers. It lists no water glass. Nothing changed there from 10:00 to 18:00. My 18:00 picture (v088) shows the same table, and the only glass is a stemmed white wine glass, not a water glass.

The banana was on the island at 10:00 (v017) and gone by 12:00 (v033). My 16:00 note and picture (v065) show the island with a woven basket of towels, a milk carton, a snack bag, a water bottle and a cutting board. There is no banana in them.

My notes call it a dark navy hardcover book, but it is the only book on the bed. It was on the duvet at every patrol from 08:00 to 20:00 on day 6, and the 20:00 picture still shows it. In the 22:00 picture the duvet is empty, so it was taken off between 20:00 and 22:00.
At 08:00 my note for the left cooktop lists an olive green oil bottle there (v004). At 10:00 the note says the olive green oil bottle was gone (v020). So it was taken off between 08:00 and 10:00.

The 20:00 picture (v099) shows no utensil on the counter beside the sink. By 22:00 (v115) a thin grey utensil, probably the table spoon, lies on the counter edge next to the sink. One caveat: at 20:00 a folded towel covered the left part of the counter, so I can't fully rule out that the spoon was hidden under it.

At 18:00 my note for the countertop beside the sink still lists a white plate in the sink and a white round plate above the faucet. The plates were also there at every visit from 10:00 to 16:00. At 20:00 my note says the white plate in the sink and the large white round plate were both gone. So the plate was taken between 18:00 and 20:00.

In the 08:00 picture (v001), an open laptop sits on the island. My note called it a large black box or case, but the screen and keyboard base can be seen. By 10:00 (v017) it is gone: my note says the black case left, and breakfast things and a basket are in its place. Later pictures show no laptop. So it was taken between 08:00 and 10:00.

In the 18:00 picture (v081), the large brown egg is still on the island, beside the green oil bottle. In the 20:00 picture (v097), it is gone, and my note for that patrol records it as gone. At 20:00 a brown egg also showed up on the left cooktop (v100), so someone likely moved it there to cook.

At 12:00 (v033) a small white folded paper, which is probably the receipt, stands on the island near the gold snack bag. At 14:00 (v049) it is not visible, and my 14:00 note records 'white folded napkin or paper gone'. The milk carton now sits roughly where the paper was, so the carton could be hiding it. That is uncertain, but the note says it is gone. By 18:00 the whole island was bare.

In the 20:00 picture of the left cooktop (v100) there is no egg, only the green bottle, a pot and the blue kettle. In the 22:00 picture (v116) a large brown egg stands on the cooktop beside the green bottle. My notes for this spot from 08:00 to 20:00 never list an egg. The egg I saw earlier was on the countertop by the range, and it was gone from there at 22:00 (v117).

My notes have no item called a water glass, so this answer assumes the ribbed glass/cup I logged as a 'cream ribbed paper cup' is that glass. The 16:00 picture shows it on the table. My 18:00 note still lists it. In the 20:00 picture it is gone, and the 20:00 note records 'cream ribbed paper cup gone'. So it was taken between 18:00 and 20:00.

My 18:00 note for the left cooktop lists empty grates, a paper bag, an orange item, a kettle, a paper towel roll and a snack bag, with no egg. At 20:00 a large brown egg 'appeared' there, along with the casserole pan, a small pot and a bowl. There was no egg on the cooktop at any patrol from 08:00 to 18:00 either, so it was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

My notes list the large brown egg on the countertop by the range at every patrol from 08:00 to 20:00 (v101 at 20:00 still shows it). At 22:00 (v117) my note says the egg is gone. A large brown egg also appeared on the left cooktop at 22:00 (v116), so it was probably moved there.

The 08:00 picture (v012) shows the black key fob with a red tag on the nightstand. The 22:00 picture (v124) shows it gone, and the 12:00 note (v044) no longer lists it, so it was taken between 08:00 and 12:00. The 10:00 note (v028) lists nothing that was there ('now: ?'), so it can't show whether the keys were still present at 10:00. The 'changes: none' notes aren't reliable here: v044 also says none, yet the pen and plug adapter had disappeared. So I can't choose between the two windows.

In the 08:00 picture of the island countertop (v001) there is no olive oil bottle. The 10:00 picture (v017) clearly shows an olive-green glass bottle with a black stopper, and the 10:00 note records it as newly appeared. The bottle stayed on the island for the rest of the day, so it was put there between 08:00 and 10:00.

The white shirt stays on the floor in every picture from 08:00 to 22:00, so it was never taken. Nothing on the floor is clearly a restaurant shirt. The only folded clothing-like item is the grey-green piece with a dark stripe, which looks like a folded towel or work shirt. It is there at 08:00 and 14:00 and gone from its spot at 16:00, and the white socks went too. That fits Julian's break at home (about 14:30-16:30) before his evening shift. Calling it his restaurant shirt is my guess.

I have no note of a spatula on this counter on day 6. The 18:00 picture (v085) shows only the pepper mill, the white bowl, the oil bottle and the crisps bag. In the 20:00 picture (v101) a long, thin, dark utensil lies flat on the left of the counter. My note called it a black kitchen knife, but it could be the silicone spatula. It was still there at 22:00. So the spatula was most likely put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

The 14:00 picture of the countertop beside the sink shows the brown bowl, the faucet, the dish rack and the orange detergent bottle, but no thermos. In the 16:00 picture a tall black thermos stands beside the sink, next to a new blue-and-white plate of food. So the thermos was put there between 14:00 and 16:00. It was still there in the later notes.

In the 18:00 picture of the desk there is no laptop: only the monitor, keyboard, mouse, tablet, water bottle and apple are there. In the 20:00 picture, a small white-silver laptop sits open at the back left of the desk, and a black case and a gold item have also appeared. So the laptop was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

There was no egg on the countertop by the range in my 18:00 picture (v085), which shows the pepper mill, a white bowl, the oil bottle and the crisps bag. In my 20:00 picture (v101), a large brown egg is in front of them. It was still there at 22:00 (v117). The egg on the island and the cooktop earlier in the day were in other places.

The 22:00 picture (v128) shows a black-and-white dress on the floor. It is not in the 16:00 picture (v080) or in the detailed 18:00 note (v096). The 20:00 note (v112) is blank, but the 22:00 check found no change since 20:00, so the dress was most likely already there at 20:00. That puts it between 18:00 and 20:00. This is an inference, because the 20:00 note itself does not show the dress.

There is no egg on the island in the 08:00 picture (v001). The 10:00 picture (v017) shows a large brown egg in front, and the 10:00 note says it appeared. It stayed there through 22:00, so it was put on the island between 08:00 and 10:00.

The pictures don't show which dark garment is the sleep shirt, so this is my best inference. At 08:00 there were two dark garments on the floor. By 10:00 one was gone and one stayed, and it was still there at 20:00. By 22:00 it was gone. The one that stayed all day is most likely the sleep shirt: dropped in the morning and picked up at bedtime. The one taken before 10:00 is more likely clothes worn for the day.

The hoodie is in the 10:00 picture (v032) and missing from the 16:00 picture (v080). The 14:00 note (v064) doesn't list it either, so it was taken between 10:00 and 14:00. But the 12:00 note (v048) has no description and no picture, so I can't tell if it went between 10:00 and 12:00 or between 12:00 and 14:00. Both the 12:00 and 14:00 notes say 'no changes', yet the pile clearly changed, so those notes can't be trusted to narrow it down.

There is no hoodie on the bathroom 2 floor in the 14:00 picture (v064). In the 16:00 picture (v080), a light grey hoodie is lying on the floor, and the notes list it as newly appeared then. So it was put there between 14:00 and 16:00.

In the 16:00 picture (v070), the coffee table has no tin on it. It holds only the photo book, the paper cup, the saucer, the mug and the bowl. In the 18:00 picture (v086), a brown vintage tin, which is the tea tin, is on the table and is noted as appearing. That means it was put there between 16:00 and 18:00.

My 08:00 note (v004) lists a steel saucepan on the left cooktop. My 10:00 note (v020) records 'steel saucepan gone'. The saucepan came back by 18:00 (v084) and was still on the range at 20:00 and 22:00, so that was the only time it was taken off on day 7. I went by my notes and did not open the pictures.
At 08:00 my note for the countertop beside the kitchen sink lists a brown patterned bowl (v003). At 10:00 the note records that bowl as gone (v019). So it was taken off between 08:00 and 10:00.

None of my notes or pictures of the sink basin on day 4 show a cast iron skillet. I have notes for all eight patrols from 08:00 to 22:00. I opened the pictures from 08:00, 10:00, 18:00, 20:00 and 22:00, and none has a skillet. They show a mug, a black bottle, a brown patterned bowl, a coffee tin, plates, detergent and a crisps bag. My memory doesn't show a skillet being put here at any time that day, so I can't give a time.

In my 16:00 picture of the counter by the range (v069), I see the oil bottle, pepper mill, crisps bag and spatula, but no carrot. In the 18:00 picture (v085), there is an orange carrot on a cutting board, along with a spoon and knives. So the carrot was put there between 16:00 and 18:00.

In the 18:00 picture the sink basin is empty, with only a plate, bottles, a towel and detergent around it. In the 20:00 picture a black pan, likely the saucepan, sits in the basin. My 20:00 note also says a black pan appeared in the basin. So it was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

The 12:00 picture of the left cooktop shows the large brown egg on the edge of the cooktop. In the 14:00 picture the egg is gone, and a saucepan and a tall black stockpot are on the burners instead. The notes say the same: the egg was there at 08:00, 10:00 and 12:00 and gone at 14:00.

answer.doing: Getting dinner ready. A cutting board with a carrot, two knives, a long wooden spoon and a small jar were set out, and a pan was put on the range. The pepper mill and spatula were put away. The cooking was left half done and carried on into the evening.
answer.explanation: At 16:00 the counter had not changed. By 18:00 the cooking things were out. Julian usually leaves for the restaurant at about 16:30 and Mara gets home at about 17:30, so this was probably Mara after she got home. The same prep was still in use at 20:00 and 22:00, with a white bag and a chili added and pans in the sink. Julian is out at those hours, so the cook was probably the person at home, Mara. It is still possible Julian started it before 16:30.

answer.doing: Clearing away the breakfast plate and pencil, then setting out cooking things (a brown egg and the green oil bottle) while getting the stove ready with pots before leaving for work.
answer.explanation: Between 08:00 and 10:00 the plate of food and the orange pencil left the island, and an egg and the olive-green oil bottle appeared. In the same window the oil bottle left the cooktop and two lidded pots were put on the burners, so someone was cooking or getting ready to. Mara usually leaves around 08:30. Julian, the chef, is home until about 09:30, so he is the likelier person, but my notes don't confirm it.

answer.doing: Eating an evening meal or having drinks at the dining table: two white cups, a plate and a black spoon were set out, the wine glass was moved, and the small white jar was taken out of the wooden bowl.
answer.explanation: At 18:00 the table had only its usual items. By 20:00 two cups, a plate and a spoon had appeared and the wine glass had moved, which looks like someone ate or drank there. Julian is usually at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30, and kitchen signs at 18:00 point to cooking: a carrot being cut and a saucepan set out. Mara is normally home after 17:30, so it was most likely her, though no one was seen.

answer.doing: Someone changed clothes on the bathroom floor. A grey hoodie and a second pair of camouflage trousers were dropped there. The white sneaker and orange-black boot were taken, and the towel, bag, jeans and glasses were moved.
answer.explanation: Comparing the 14:00 and 16:00 pictures: a grey hoodie and a second pair of camo trousers appeared, the white sneaker and orange boot are gone, and the other items were moved. This happened during Julian's usual break between shifts (about 14:30–16:30), when Mara is normally at her studio. My notes link this floor to Julian. So he probably changed and put on his shoes before going back to the restaurant.

answer.doing: Having breakfast at the island: milk, a yogurt, a banana, a green bowl, snack bags and a wooden cutting board were left out, and the big dark basket was moved into a different position.
answer.explanation: At 08:00 the island had only the dark basket, seen up close, and a gold snack bag. By 10:00 breakfast food and a bowl were left out. The range and the counter next to it also show breakfast cooking in this window. Mara usually leaves around 08:30, but Julian stays until about 09:30 and cooks a lot at home, so the last person here was most likely Julian. Mara may have joined him earlier, but the pictures can't show that.

answer.doing: Someone probably cooked a midday meal. They took the egg, the dark canister and the small blue kettle off the cooktop and put a steel saucepan with a long handle and a tall black stockpot on the burners.
answer.explanation: Pots for cooking were swapped onto the range. At the same time an oil bottle and frying pan came out by the range, the cutting board and oil were used and moved on the island, and a plate with food was left in the sink. Julian is normally at the restaurant until 14:30 and Mara at her studio. The midday red handbag and second pair of sneakers point to someone unexpected at home. None of these items belongs to either person, so I can't tell who cooked.

answer.doing: Sorting or picking up the clothes on the bathroom floor, maybe getting changed or gathering laundry. The camouflage trousers, a white shirt, a black shoe and a white sock were taken. The black bag and the striped sock were moved, and orange-and-black trousers were dropped in view.
answer.explanation: The 20:00 and 22:00 pictures show clothes taken, moved and added, so someone handled this pile in the evening. Julian is usually at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30. That evening the kitchen, dining table and nightstand all show someone at home, including Mara's tan wallet appearing on the nightstand by 22:00.
